edition_title.en: URI redirects settle as heartbeat and session timing recover
edition_title.fr: Les redirects URI se stabilisent, heartbeat et sessions se rétablissent
edition_title.zh: URI redirect 稳定，heartbeat 与 session 计时恢复
edition_title.ru: URI redirects стабилизированы, heartbeat и sessions восстановлены

intro.en: The URI stack is rewritten around RFC 3986 parsing and relative Location resolution, then stabilized through build 2.4.17187 before HTTP clients adopt it for redirects. Production users also receive the successor fix for disabled async WebSocket heartbeats, corrected signed-URI and REST session timeouts, safer proxy-cache startup and shutdown, and optional Windows IOCP direct writes. External callers of ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError have one source migration to make.
intro.fr: La pile URI est réécrite selon RFC 3986 avec résolution des Location relatives, puis stabilisée jusqu’à la build 2.4.17187 avant son adoption par les redirects HTTP. Les utilisateurs en production reçoivent aussi le correctif successeur des heartbeats WebSocket async désactivés, des timeouts Signed URI et REST corrigés, un proxy cache plus sûr au démarrage et à l’arrêt, et les écritures IOCP directes optionnelles sous Windows. Les appels externes à ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError doivent migrer.
intro.zh: URI 栈按 RFC 3986 重写并支持相对 Location 解析，随后在 HTTP client redirect 采用之前持续修正至 build 2.4.17187。生产用户还获得异步 WebSocket heartbeat 停止问题的后续修复、正确的 Signed URI 与 REST session timeout、更安全的 proxy-cache 启停，以及可选的 Windows IOCP 直接写入。外部 ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError 调用需要迁移。
intro.ru: URI stack переписан по RFC 3986 с разрешением relative Location и стабилизирован к build 2.4.17187 до применения в HTTP redirects. Production получает successor fix отключённых async WebSocket heartbeats, корректные Signed URI и REST session timeouts, безопасный startup/shutdown proxy cache и опциональную direct IOCP write на Windows. Внешние вызовы ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError требуют миграции.

en: Land on upstream head 215c7bbd240419735ad7e89f5d35ddc9cfeb8b4d at build 2.4.17187 for the completed URI and redirect sequence.
Build 2.4.17171 restores async WebSocket heartbeat callbacks disabled by the previous idle-loop comparison.
Signed URI timestamp ordering and REST session timeout arithmetic are corrected for long-running services and 32-bit tick rollover.
Windows proxy caches can use direct IOCP writes and now avoid startup and background-deletion races.
Replace external ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError calls with ESynSspi.RaiseSspiError.
Avoid builds 2.4.17162–2.4.17170 for heartbeat users and 2.4.17176–2.4.17186 for the incomplete URI sequence.
fr: Visez le head 215c7bbd240419735ad7e89f5d35ddc9cfeb8b4d, build 2.4.17187, pour la séquence URI et redirect complète.
La build 2.4.17171 rétablit les callbacks heartbeat WebSocket async désactivés par la comparaison idle précédente.
L’ordre des timestamps Signed URI et le calcul du timeout REST sont corrigés pour les services longs et le rollover 32-bit.
Les proxy caches Windows peuvent écrire directement via IOCP et évitent des races de démarrage et suppression.
Remplacez les appels externes ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError par ESynSspi.RaiseSspiError.
Évitez 2.4.17162–2.4.17170 pour heartbeat et 2.4.17176–2.4.17186 pour la séquence URI incomplète.
zh: 采用 upstream head 215c7bbd240419735ad7e89f5d35ddc9cfeb8b4d，即 build 2.4.17187，以获得完整 URI 与 redirect 修复序列。
Build 2.4.17171 恢复被上一版 idle-loop 比较禁用的异步 WebSocket heartbeat callback。
Signed URI timestamp 顺序与 REST session timeout 算法已修正，覆盖长期运行服务及 32-bit tick rollover。
Windows proxy cache 可使用 IOCP 直接写入，并避开启动与后台删除 race。
将外部 ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError 调用替换为 ESynSspi.RaiseSspiError。
ru: Переходите на head 215c7bbd240419735ad7e89f5d35ddc9cfeb8b4d, build 2.4.17187, с завершённой URI/redirect серией.
Build 2.4.17171 восстанавливает async WebSocket heartbeat callbacks, отключённые прежним idle-loop сравнением.
Порядок Signed URI timestamps и REST session timeout исправлены для долгих процессов и 32-bit rollover.
Windows proxy cache получил direct IOCP writes и защиту от startup/background-deletion races.
Замените внешние вызовы ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError на ESynSspi.RaiseSspiError.
Избегайте 2.4.17162–2.4.17170 для heartbeat и 2.4.17176–2.4.17186 для незавершённой URI серии.

summary.en: TUri gains allocation-free buffer and Location parsers, stricter RFC 3986 validation and coherent scheme state; THttpClientSocket then uses the parser for 3xx Location handling after follow-up cross-origin and recovery fixes.
summary.fr: TUri gagne des parsers buffer et Location sans allocation, une validation RFC 3986 stricte et un état scheme cohérent ; THttpClientSocket l’utilise pour Location après les correctifs cross-origin et recovery.
summary.zh: TUri 新增无分配 buffer/Location parser、严格 RFC 3986 校验与一致 scheme 状态；THttpClientSocket 在 cross-origin 与恢复修复后将其用于 3xx Location。
summary.ru: TUri получил allocation-free buffer/Location parsers, строгую RFC 3986 validation и согласованный scheme; THttpClientSocket применяет его к 3xx Location после cross-origin/recovery fixes.

title.zh: Proxy 与异步网络可靠性

summary.en: Proxy-cache startup and deletion avoid unsafe URL access, SQUID connections gain compatible keep-alive and forced-reconnect controls, Windows IOCP may write directly, and WebSocket heartbeat scheduling is repaired.
summary.fr: Le proxy cache sécurise démarrage et suppression, SQUID gagne keep-alive et reconnexion compatibles, Windows IOCP peut écrire directement et le heartbeat WebSocket est réparé.
summary.zh: Proxy cache 避免启停期间不安全 URL 访问，SQUID 获得兼容 keep-alive 与强制重连，Windows IOCP 可直接写入，WebSocket heartbeat 调度恢复。
summary.ru: Proxy cache защищён при startup/deletion, SQUID получил совместимые keep-alive/reconnect, Windows IOCP — direct write, а WebSocket heartbeat исправлен.

title.zh: Timeout 与 cache 正确性

summary.en: Signed URI authentication, REST sessions, SOA discovery, TSynCache and weekly HTTP rotation all correct reversed or lossy time comparisons that could expire, retain or skip work at the wrong moment.
summary.fr: Signed URI, sessions REST, découverte SOA, TSynCache et rotation HTTP hebdomadaire corrigent des comparaisons inversées ou imprécises.
summary.zh: Signed URI authentication、REST session、SOA discovery、TSynCache 与每周 HTTP rotation 修正了反向或有损时间比较。
summary.ru: Signed URI, REST sessions, SOA discovery, TSynCache и weekly HTTP rotation исправляют обратные или неточные time comparisons.

land_on.why: Finalizes the URI/redirect sequence and includes the heartbeat, authentication, timeout and proxy-cache repairs.

avoid.why: The async WebSocket heartbeat regression from the preceding edition remains present; build 2.4.17171 corrects the idle-loop comparison.
The TUri and redirect rewrite receives parsing, cross-origin, scheme-state and regression-test fixes through build 2.4.17187.

order.why: Take the URI parser and redirect integration as one completed sequence.
Apply both authentication and session-expiry timing fixes.
Take the proxy-cache lifecycle and Windows IOCP scaling changes together.

upgrade_advice.en: Upgrade to build 2.4.17187 at head 215c7bbd240419735ad7e89f5d35ddc9cfeb8b4d rather than stopping inside the URI rewrite. WebSocket, Signed URI, REST session, SOA discovery and proxy-cache users should prioritize the update. Before compiling external code, replace ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError with ESynSspi.RaiseSspiError; then regression-test relative redirects, credential policy and Windows proxy throughput.
upgrade_advice.fr: Passez à la build 2.4.17187 au head 215c7bbd240419735ad7e89f5d35ddc9cfeb8b4d sans vous arrêter dans la réécriture URI. Priorité aux utilisateurs WebSocket, Signed URI, sessions REST, SOA et proxy cache. Remplacez ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError par ESynSspi.RaiseSspiError, puis testez redirects relatifs, credentials et débit proxy Windows.
upgrade_advice.zh: 升级到 head 215c7bbd240419735ad7e89f5d35ddc9cfeb8b4d 的 build 2.4.17187，不要停在 URI 重写中间版本。WebSocket、Signed URI、REST session、SOA discovery 与 proxy-cache 用户应优先升级。编译外部代码前将 ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError 替换为 ESynSspi.RaiseSspiError，并回归测试相对 redirect、credential policy 与 Windows proxy 吞吐。
upgrade_advice.ru: Обновляйтесь до build 2.4.17187 в head 215c7bbd240419735ad7e89f5d35ddc9cfeb8b4d, не останавливаясь внутри URI rewrite. Приоритет для WebSocket, Signed URI, REST session, SOA и proxy cache. Замените ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError на ESynSspi.RaiseSspiError и проверьте relative redirects, credentials и Windows proxy throughput.

notes.en: Reviewed all 26 non-merge commits from build 2.4.17162 through 2.4.17187: 989 additions and 286 deletions outside version bookkeeping. The raw payload has no superseded_by metadata; the avoid windows come from directly inspected fixes to the same routines. No unresolved final-head defect was identified.
notes.fr: Les 26 commits non-merge de 2.4.17162 à 2.4.17187 ont été examinés : 989 ajouts et 286 suppressions hors version bookkeeping. Aucun superseded_by ; les plages à éviter viennent de correctifs inspectés dans les mêmes routines. Aucun défaut final non résolu identifié.
notes.zh: 已审查 build 2.4.17162 至 2.4.17187 的全部 26 个 non-merge commit：除版本 bookkeeping 外新增 989 行、删除 286 行。raw payload 无 superseded_by；避开区间来自对同一 routine 后续修复的直接检查。未发现最终 head 的未解决缺陷。
notes.ru: Проверены все 26 non-merge commits от 2.4.17162 до 2.4.17187: 989 additions и 286 deletions без version bookkeeping. superseded_by отсутствует; avoid windows основаны на проверенных fixes тех же routines. Нерешённых дефектов final head не найдено.

headline.en: TUri.FromScheme now keeps textual and enum schemes coherent
headline.fr: TUri.FromScheme synchronise les schemes texte et enum
headline.zh: TUri.FromScheme 现保持文本与枚举 scheme 一致
headline.ru: TUri.FromScheme согласует text и enum scheme

what_changed.en: TUri.FromScheme now assigns Scheme from the TUriScheme lookup in addition to UriScheme, with regression coverage for HTTP, HTTPS, WS, WSS, FTP and LDAPS.
what_changed.fr: TUri.FromScheme affecte désormais Scheme depuis TUriScheme en plus de UriScheme, avec tests HTTP, HTTPS, WS, WSS, FTP et LDAPS.
what_changed.zh: TUri.FromScheme 除 UriScheme 外还会从 TUriScheme lookup 设置 Scheme，并加入 HTTP、HTTPS、WS、WSS、FTP、LDAPS 回归测试。
what_changed.ru: TUri.FromScheme теперь задаёт Scheme из TUriScheme вместе с UriScheme; добавлены tests HTTP, HTTPS, WS, WSS, FTP и LDAPS.

impact.en: Callers using URI, SameUri or Https after FromScheme now receive the expected scheme; code stopping at build 2.4.17186 can construct internally inconsistent TUri values.
impact.fr: URI, SameUri et Https après FromScheme reçoivent le scheme attendu ; 2.4.17186 peut produire un TUri incohérent.
impact.zh: FromScheme 后使用 URI、SameUri 或 Https 的调用方现获得正确 scheme；停在 2.4.17186 可能构造不一致的 TUri。
impact.ru: URI, SameUri и Https после FromScheme получают верный scheme; 2.4.17186 мог создавать несогласованный TUri.

action_detail.en: Land on build 2.4.17187 and test every FromScheme call that later reads Scheme, URI or Https.
action_detail.fr: Visez 2.4.17187 et testez les appels FromScheme lisant Scheme, URI ou Https.
action_detail.zh: 采用 2.4.17187，并测试随后读取 Scheme、URI 或 Https 的 FromScheme 调用。
action_detail.ru: Переходите на 2.4.17187 и тестируйте FromScheme с чтением Scheme, URI или Https.

note.en: Now initializes both UriScheme and Scheme.
note.zh: 现同时初始化 UriScheme 与 Scheme。

headline.en: REST session expiry no longer loses timeout precision
headline.fr: L’expiration REST ne perd plus de précision
headline.zh: REST session 过期不再丢失 timeout 精度
headline.ru: REST session expiry больше не теряет точность

what_changed.en: TAuthSession computes fTimeOutShr10 by multiplying SessionTimeout by MilliSecsPerMin before shifting, instead of truncating the per-minute factor first.
what_changed.fr: TAuthSession multiplie SessionTimeout par MilliSecsPerMin avant le décalage, au lieu de tronquer d’abord le facteur par minute.
what_changed.zh: TAuthSession 先将 SessionTimeout 乘以 MilliSecsPerMin 再位移，不再提前截断每分钟因子。
what_changed.ru: TAuthSession умножает SessionTimeout на MilliSecsPerMin до shift вместо раннего усечения минутного коэффициента.

impact.en: Long-lived Delphi and FPC servers stop expiring idle sessions slightly early; a 60-minute setting previously lost up to roughly 36 seconds.
impact.fr: Les serveurs Delphi/FPC n’expirent plus les sessions légèrement trop tôt ; 60 minutes perdaient environ 36 secondes.
impact.zh: 长期运行的 Delphi/FPC server 不再略微提前使 idle session 过期；60 分钟设置此前最多损失约 36 秒。
impact.ru: Delphi/FPC servers больше не завершают idle sessions немного раньше; 60 минут теряли около 36 секунд.

action_detail.en: Upgrade REST servers that depend on precise SessionTimeout boundaries and recheck expiry tests.
action_detail.fr: Mettez à niveau les serveurs REST dépendant de limites SessionTimeout précises.
action_detail.zh: 依赖精确 SessionTimeout 边界的 REST server 应升级并重测过期逻辑。
action_detail.ru: Обновите REST servers с точными границами SessionTimeout и повторите expiry tests.

headline.en: FromScheme receives focused protocol tests
headline.fr: FromScheme reçoit des tests protocolaires ciblés
headline.zh: FromScheme 获得针对性协议测试
headline.ru: FromScheme получил целевые protocol tests

what_changed.en: Network protocol tests add assertions for TUri.FromScheme across HTTP, HTTPS, WS, WSS, FTP, FTPS, LDAP and LDAPS before the final implementation fix.
what_changed.fr: Les tests réseau couvrent TUri.FromScheme pour HTTP, HTTPS, WS, WSS, FTP, FTPS, LDAP et LDAPS avant le correctif final.
what_changed.zh: 网络协议测试在最终实现修复前覆盖 TUri.FromScheme 的 HTTP、HTTPS、WS、WSS、FTP、FTPS、LDAP 与 LDAPS。
what_changed.ru: Network tests покрывают TUri.FromScheme для HTTP, HTTPS, WS, WSS, FTP, FTPS, LDAP и LDAPS до final fix.

impact.en: No application code changes; the added checks exposed the scheme-state defect fixed by the following commit.
impact.fr: Aucun changement applicatif ; les tests ont révélé le défaut corrigé ensuite.
impact.zh: 应用代码无影响；新增检查暴露了下一 commit 修复的 scheme-state 缺陷。
impact.ru: Application code не меняется; tests выявили defect, исправленный следующим commit.

action_detail.en: Take with the final FromScheme implementation fix.
action_detail.fr: Prenez avec le correctif final FromScheme.
action_detail.zh: 与最终 FromScheme 实现修复一并采用。
action_detail.ru: Берите вместе с final FromScheme fix.

headline.en: Redirect origin checks and retry state are stabilized
headline.fr: Les contrôles d’origine et l’état retry sont stabilisés
headline.zh: Redirect origin 检查与 retry 状态稳定
headline.ru: Redirect origin checks и retry state стабилизированы

what_changed.en: THttpClientSocket computes cross-origin state only after parsing the new Location, removes the transient RedirectCrossOrigin field, restores saved HTTP state when reopening fails, and TUri.FromScheme records UriScheme.
what_changed.fr: THttpClientSocket calcule cross-origin après parsing de Location, supprime RedirectCrossOrigin, restaure l’état HTTP si reopen échoue et FromScheme renseigne UriScheme.
what_changed.zh: THttpClientSocket 在解析新 Location 后才计算 cross-origin，移除临时 RedirectCrossOrigin 字段，reopen 失败时恢复 HTTP 状态；FromScheme 记录 UriScheme。
what_changed.ru: THttpClientSocket считает cross-origin после parsing Location, удаляет RedirectCrossOrigin, восстанавливает HTTP state при reopen failure; FromScheme задаёт UriScheme.

impact.en: Redirect credential policy is evaluated against the actual target and failed reconnects no longer leave client state half-mutated.
impact.fr: La policy credentials utilise la cible réelle et un reconnect échoué ne laisse plus l’état partiel.
impact.zh: Redirect credential policy 现基于实际目标判断，reconnect 失败不再留下半修改 client 状态。
impact.ru: Redirect credential policy использует реальную цель, а failed reconnect не оставляет client state частично изменённым.

action_detail.en: Do not stop on build 2.4.17183; take this stabilization and the final FromScheme fix.
action_detail.fr: Ne restez pas sur 2.4.17183 ; prenez ce correctif et le fix final FromScheme.
action_detail.zh: 不要停在 2.4.17183；采用此稳定修复及最终 FromScheme 修复。
action_detail.ru: Не оставайтесь на 2.4.17183; берите этот fix и final FromScheme fix.

headline.en: HTTP redirects resolve Location through TUri
headline.fr: Les redirects HTTP résolvent Location via TUri
headline.zh: HTTP redirect 通过 TUri 解析 Location
headline.ru: HTTP redirects разрешают Location через TUri

what_changed.en: THttpClientSocket replaces manual 3xx Location string handling with TUri.FromLocation, lets OnRedirect alter Location and options, and derives reconnect, credential and rejection decisions from the parsed URI.
what_changed.fr: THttpClientSocket remplace le parsing manuel par TUri.FromLocation, laisse OnRedirect modifier Location/options et décide reconnect, credentials et rejet depuis l’URI parsée.
what_changed.zh: THttpClientSocket 用 TUri.FromLocation 替代手工 3xx Location 字符串处理，允许 OnRedirect 修改 Location/options，并基于解析 URI 决定重连、credential 与拒绝。
what_changed.ru: THttpClientSocket заменяет ручной parsing на TUri.FromLocation, позволяет OnRedirect менять Location/options и принимает reconnect/credential/reject решения по parsed URI.

impact.en: Relative, absolute and scheme-relative redirects are handled consistently, but this first integration requires the following cross-origin fix before production use.
impact.fr: Les redirects relatifs, absolus et scheme-relative sont cohérents, mais ce premier port nécessite le correctif suivant.
impact.zh: 相对、绝对及 scheme-relative redirect 获得一致处理，但此初始集成需要后续 cross-origin 修复后才能用于生产。
impact.ru: Relative, absolute и scheme-relative redirects единообразны, но initial integration требует следующего cross-origin fix.

action_detail.en: Take only as part of the completed sequence through build 2.4.17187 and test redirect callbacks.
action_detail.fr: Prenez seulement la séquence complète jusqu’à 2.4.17187 et testez les callbacks.
action_detail.zh: 仅作为截至 2.4.17187 的完整序列采用，并测试 redirect callback。
action_detail.ru: Берите только полной серией до 2.4.17187 и тестируйте redirect callbacks.

note.zh: 改用符合 RFC 3986 的 TUri.FromLocation。

headline.en: URI validation follows RFC 3986 edge cases
headline.fr: La validation URI suit les cas limites RFC 3986
headline.zh: URI 校验遵循 RFC 3986 边界规则
headline.ru: URI validation учитывает края RFC 3986

what_changed.en: TUri parsing rejects a colon in the first segment of a relative path, tightens authority, port and Location validation, and expands regression coverage for valid and malformed references.
what_changed.fr: TUri refuse les deux-points dans le premier segment relatif, renforce authority/port/Location et étend les tests.
what_changed.zh: TUri parsing 拒绝相对路径首 segment 中的冒号，收紧 authority、port 与 Location 校验，并扩充有效及畸形引用测试。
what_changed.ru: TUri parsing запрещает colon в первом relative segment, ужесточает authority/port/Location validation и расширяет tests.

impact.en: Malformed redirect targets are rejected instead of being ambiguously interpreted; valid RFC 3986 relative references remain supported on Delphi and FPC.
impact.fr: Les cibles malformées sont rejetées sans ambiguïté ; les références relatives RFC 3986 valides restent supportées.
impact.zh: 畸形 redirect 目标不再被模糊解释；Delphi/FPC 仍支持有效 RFC 3986 相对引用。
impact.ru: Malformed redirect targets отвергаются, valid RFC 3986 relative references поддерживаются в Delphi/FPC.

action_detail.en: Include in the full URI sequence and test any nonstandard Location values accepted by your services.
action_detail.fr: Incluez dans la séquence URI complète et testez vos Location non standards.
action_detail.zh: 纳入完整 URI 序列，并测试服务接受的非标准 Location。
action_detail.ru: Включите в полную URI серию и проверьте nonstandard Location ваших services.

note.en: Malformed RFC 3986 references are rejected more strictly.
note.fr: Les références RFC 3986 malformées sont refusées plus strictement.
note.zh: 更严格拒绝畸形 RFC 3986 引用。

headline.en: Signed URI sessions survive tick rollover correctly
headline.fr: Les sessions Signed URI gèrent correctement le rollover
headline.zh: Signed URI session 正确处理 tick rollover
headline.ru: Signed URI sessions корректно переживают tick rollover

what_changed.en: TRestServerAuthenticationSignedUri.RetrieveSession compares timestamps with signed modular deltas, updates its last timestamp only when newer, and aligns startup and 32-bit rollover handling.
what_changed.fr: RetrieveSession compare les timestamps par delta modulaire signé, ne met à jour le dernier que s’il est plus récent et aligne startup/rollover 32-bit.
what_changed.zh: TRestServerAuthenticationSignedUri.RetrieveSession 使用有符号模差比较 timestamp，仅在更新时记录，并统一启动与 32-bit rollover 处理。
what_changed.ru: RetrieveSession сравнивает timestamps signed modular delta, обновляет last только для более нового и выравнивает startup/32-bit rollover.

impact.en: Long-running signed-URI services no longer reject or misorder otherwise valid authentication timestamps around process start and tick wrap.
impact.fr: Les services Signed URI longs ne rejettent plus des timestamps valides près du démarrage ou du rollover.
impact.zh: 长期运行的 Signed URI 服务不再在进程启动或 tick 回绕附近误拒绝或错序有效 authentication timestamp。
impact.ru: Long-running Signed URI services больше не отвергают valid timestamps около startup или tick wrap.

action_detail.en: Prioritize this commit for Signed URI authentication and test replay windows across simulated rollover.
action_detail.fr: Priorisez ce commit pour Signed URI et testez les fenêtres replay au rollover.
action_detail.zh: Signed URI authentication 应优先采用，并在模拟 rollover 下测试 replay window。
action_detail.ru: Приоритетно обновите Signed URI authentication и проверьте replay windows через rollover.

headline.en: URI and Location parsing gain broad regression coverage
headline.fr: Le parsing URI et Location gagne une large couverture
headline.zh: URI 与 Location parsing 获得广泛回归覆盖
headline.ru: URI и Location parsing получили широкие regression tests

what_changed.en: The network test suite adds extensive valid and invalid cases for TUri.From and TUri.FromLocation, including authority, IPv6, ports, query, fragment and relative resolution.
what_changed.fr: Les tests ajoutent de nombreux cas valides et invalides pour From/FromLocation : authority, IPv6, ports, query, fragment et résolution relative.
what_changed.zh: 网络测试为 TUri.From 与 TUri.FromLocation 添加大量有效/无效案例，覆盖 authority、IPv6、port、query、fragment 与相对解析。
what_changed.ru: Network tests добавляют множество valid/invalid случаев From/FromLocation: authority, IPv6, ports, query, fragment и relative resolution.

impact.en: No direct application change; the tests constrain the parser rewrite and expose regressions corrected by later commits.
impact.fr: Aucun changement applicatif ; les tests encadrent la réécriture et révèlent les régressions suivantes.
impact.zh: 应用代码无直接影响；这些测试约束 parser 重写并暴露后续 commit 修复的回归。
impact.ru: Application code не меняется; tests фиксируют parser contract и выявляют последующие regressions.

action_detail.en: Use these cases when validating custom URI inputs after upgrading.
action_detail.fr: Réutilisez ces cas pour valider vos URI après upgrade.
action_detail.zh: 升级后验证自定义 URI 输入时可参考这些案例。
action_detail.ru: Используйте эти cases для проверки custom URI после upgrade.

headline.en: Initial URI parser defects are corrected
headline.fr: Les défauts initiaux du parser URI sont corrigés
headline.zh: 初始 URI parser 缺陷已修正
headline.ru: Initial URI parser defects исправлены

what_changed.en: TUri.From and FromLocation correct direct string-length handling, reject an empty explicit port, repair type and boundary checks, and fix relative-resolution output discovered by tests.
what_changed.fr: From et FromLocation corrigent la longueur directe, refusent un port explicite vide, réparent types/limites et la résolution relative.
what_changed.zh: TUri.From 与 FromLocation 修正直接字符串长度处理，拒绝空的显式 port，修复类型、边界检查及测试发现的相对解析输出。
what_changed.ru: TUri.From/FromLocation исправляют string length, отвергают пустой explicit port, чинят types/bounds и relative-resolution output.

impact.en: Applications should not use the initial builds of the new parser because malformed ports and some input lengths could be handled incorrectly.
impact.fr: N’utilisez pas les premières builds du parser : ports malformés et certaines longueurs étaient mal traités.
impact.zh: 应用不应使用新 parser 的初始 build，因为畸形 port 与部分输入长度可能被错误处理。
impact.ru: Не используйте initial parser builds: malformed ports и некоторые lengths обрабатывались неверно.

action_detail.en: Take this and all later URI fixes through build 2.4.17187.
action_detail.fr: Prenez ce commit et tous les fixes URI jusqu’à 2.4.17187.
action_detail.zh: 采用此 commit 及截至 2.4.17187 的全部后续 URI 修复。
action_detail.ru: Берите этот и все последующие URI fixes до 2.4.17187.

headline.en: TUri can resolve HTTP Location values without allocation
headline.fr: TUri résout Location sans allocation
headline.zh: TUri 可无分配解析 HTTP Location
headline.ru: TUri разрешает HTTP Location без allocation

what_changed.en: A public TUri.FromLocation method resolves absolute, scheme-relative, root-relative and path-relative Location values against a server, port and TLS context.
what_changed.fr: La méthode publique TUri.FromLocation résout les Location absolues, scheme-relative, root-relative et path-relative selon serveur, port et TLS.
what_changed.zh: 新增 public TUri.FromLocation，可根据 server、port 与 TLS context 解析绝对、scheme-relative、root-relative 和 path-relative Location。
what_changed.ru: Public TUri.FromLocation разрешает absolute, scheme-relative, root-relative и path-relative Location по server, port и TLS context.

impact.en: Delphi and FPC HTTP code can replace ad hoc redirect string manipulation with a single allocation-free parser, but should take its follow-up fixes.
impact.fr: Le code HTTP Delphi/FPC peut remplacer le parsing manuel, mais doit prendre les correctifs suivants.
impact.zh: Delphi/FPC HTTP 代码可用单个无分配 parser 替代临时字符串操作，但应同时采用后续修复。
impact.ru: Delphi/FPC HTTP code может заменить ad hoc parsing одним allocation-free parser, но нужны follow-up fixes.

action_detail.en: Adopt only at final build 2.4.17187 and test relative Location forms used by your servers.
action_detail.fr: Adoptez seulement en 2.4.17187 et testez vos Location relatives.
action_detail.zh: 仅在最终 build 2.4.17187 采用，并测试服务使用的相对 Location。
action_detail.ru: Применяйте только в 2.4.17187 и тестируйте relative Location ваших servers.

note.fr: Resolver public de Location conforme RFC 3986.
note.zh: 新增 public RFC 3986-aware Location resolver。

headline.en: TUri.From coverage expands after the rewrite
headline.fr: La couverture de TUri.From s’étend après la réécriture
headline.zh: TUri.From 重写后扩充测试覆盖
headline.ru: TUri.From coverage расширен после rewrite

what_changed.en: Network tests add URI cases for credentials, IPv6 literals, explicit ports, paths, queries, fragments and malformed input after the parser rewrite.
what_changed.fr: Les tests ajoutent credentials, IPv6, ports explicites, paths, queries, fragments et entrées malformées.
what_changed.zh: 网络测试在 parser 重写后新增 credential、IPv6 literal、显式 port、path、query、fragment 与畸形输入案例。
what_changed.ru: Network tests добавляют credentials, IPv6 literals, explicit ports, paths, queries, fragments и malformed input.

impact.en: No application code impact; the expanded suite supports later parser corrections.
impact.fr: Aucun impact applicatif ; la suite soutient les correctifs suivants.
impact.zh: 应用代码无影响；扩充测试支撑后续 parser 修正。
impact.ru: Application code не затронут; suite поддерживает последующие parser fixes.

action_detail.en: No action beyond taking the complete URI sequence.
action_detail.fr: Aucune action hors séquence URI complète.
action_detail.zh: 除采用完整 URI 序列外无需操作。
action_detail.ru: Действий нет, кроме полной URI серии.

headline.en: TUri parsing is rewritten around bounded buffers
headline.fr: Le parsing TUri est réécrit autour de buffers bornés
headline.zh: TUri parsing 围绕有界 buffer 重写
headline.ru: TUri parsing переписан на bounded buffers

what_changed.en: TUri.From is rewritten and delegates to a new public FromBuffer method that parses scheme, user information, IPv6 authority, port, path, query and fragment from bounded pointers.
what_changed.fr: TUri.From est réécrit via la nouvelle méthode publique FromBuffer pour scheme, user info, IPv6, port, path, query et fragment.
what_changed.zh: TUri.From 重写并委托给新增 public FromBuffer，从有界 pointer 解析 scheme、user info、IPv6 authority、port、path、query 与 fragment。
what_changed.ru: TUri.From переписан через новый public FromBuffer для scheme, user info, IPv6 authority, port, path, query и fragment.

impact.en: URI parsing behavior changes broadly and gains an allocation-free entry point; the initial implementation is incomplete without the following fixes.
impact.fr: Le comportement URI change largement avec une entrée sans allocation ; cette première version nécessite les fixes suivants.
impact.zh: URI parsing 行为广泛变化并新增无分配入口；初始实现需配合后续修复。
impact.ru: URI parsing существенно меняется и получает allocation-free entry point; initial implementation требует последующих fixes.

action_detail.en: Do not cherry-pick alone; land the whole sequence through 2.4.17187.
action_detail.fr: Ne cherry-pickez pas seul ; prenez toute la séquence jusqu’à 2.4.17187.
action_detail.zh: 不要单独 cherry-pick；采用截至 2.4.17187 的完整序列。
action_detail.ru: Не cherry-pick отдельно; берите всю серию до 2.4.17187.

note.en: Parses a bounded URI buffer with an optional default port.
note.fr: Parse un buffer URI borné avec port par défaut optionnel.
note.zh: 解析有界 URI buffer，并支持可选默认 port。
note.ru: Парсит bounded URI buffer с optional default port.

note.en: Now uses the new bounded RFC-oriented parser.
note.fr: Utilise le nouveau parser borné orienté RFC.
note.zh: 现使用新的有界 RFC-oriented parser。
note.ru: Теперь использует новый bounded RFC-oriented parser.

headline.en: Async connection garbage collection handles tick rollover
headline.fr: Le GC async gère le rollover des ticks
headline.zh: 异步连接 GC 正确处理 tick rollover
headline.ru: Async connection GC учитывает tick rollover

what_changed.en: TAsyncConnections.OneGC uses unsigned elapsed-time subtraction and clamps future last-operation values, making idle cleanup valid across 32-bit tick wrap.
what_changed.fr: OneGC utilise une soustraction elapsed non signée et borne les valeurs futures pour le rollover 32-bit.
what_changed.zh: TAsyncConnections.OneGC 使用无符号 elapsed-time 相减并限制未来 last-operation 值，使 idle cleanup 可跨 32-bit tick 回绕。
what_changed.ru: TAsyncConnections.OneGC использует unsigned elapsed subtraction и clamp future values для 32-bit tick wrap.

impact.en: Long-running async Delphi/FPC servers no longer delay or trigger connection garbage collection incorrectly around timer rollover.
impact.fr: Les serveurs async longs ne décalent ou déclenchent plus mal le GC au rollover.
impact.zh: 长期运行的异步 Delphi/FPC server 不再在 timer rollover 附近错误延迟或触发连接 GC。
impact.ru: Long-running async Delphi/FPC servers больше не ошибаются с connection GC около timer rollover.

action_detail.en: Upgrade long-running async servers and exercise idle connection cleanup.
action_detail.fr: Mettez à niveau les serveurs async longs et testez le cleanup idle.
action_detail.zh: 升级长期运行的异步 server，并测试 idle connection cleanup。
action_detail.ru: Обновите long-running async servers и проверьте idle connection cleanup.

headline.en: SOA discovery honors live publication timeouts
headline.fr: La découverte SOA respecte les timeouts actifs
headline.zh: SOA discovery 正确遵守有效 publication timeout
headline.ru: SOA discovery учитывает активные publication timeouts

what_changed.en: TServicesPublishedInterfacesList reverses expired/live comparisons so valid published interfaces remain visible and expiring entries can refresh their checksum state.
what_changed.fr: TServicesPublishedInterfacesList corrige les comparaisons expired/live pour conserver les interfaces valides et renouveler les entrées expirables.
what_changed.zh: TServicesPublishedInterfacesList 修正 expired/live 反向比较，使有效 published interface 保持可见，并允许有期限条目刷新 checksum 状态。
what_changed.ru: TServicesPublishedInterfacesList исправляет expired/live comparisons, сохраняя valid interfaces и обновляя expiring entries.

impact.en: Service discovery with nonzero publication timeouts stops hiding live services or skipping required refresh work.
impact.fr: La découverte avec timeout non nul ne masque plus les services actifs et ne saute plus leur refresh.
impact.zh: 使用非零 publication timeout 的服务发现不再隐藏有效服务或跳过必要刷新。
impact.ru: Service discovery с nonzero timeout больше не скрывает live services и не пропускает refresh.

action_detail.en: Prioritize for SOA registries using expiring publications and verify discovery renewal.
action_detail.fr: Priorisez les registres SOA à publications expirables et vérifiez le renewal.
action_detail.zh: 使用到期 publication 的 SOA registry 应优先升级并验证 discovery renewal。
action_detail.ru: Приоритетно обновите SOA registries с expiring publications и проверьте renewal.

headline.en: Weekly HTTP rotation triggers at the correct time
headline.fr: La rotation HTTP hebdomadaire se déclenche au bon moment
headline.zh: 每周 HTTP rotation 在正确时间触发
headline.ru: Weekly HTTP rotation срабатывает вовремя

what_changed.en: THttpRotater reverses its tick comparison so weekly rotation runs when the current tick reaches NextTix32 rather than while the deadline is still ahead.
what_changed.fr: THttpRotater inverse la comparaison pour tourner quand Tix32 atteint NextTix32, pas avant.
what_changed.zh: THttpRotater 修正 tick 比较，仅在当前 tick 达到 NextTix32 时执行每周 rotation，而非 deadline 尚未到达时。
what_changed.ru: THttpRotater исправляет comparison: rotation выполняется при достижении NextTix32, а не до deadline.

impact.en: Backends relying on weekly HTTP log or file rotation resume the intended schedule instead of rotating at the wrong time.
impact.fr: Les backends dépendant de la rotation hebdomadaire retrouvent le calendrier prévu.
impact.zh: 依赖每周 HTTP log/file rotation 的 backend 恢复预期调度，不再在错误时间轮换。
impact.ru: Backends с weekly HTTP log/file rotation возвращаются к правильному schedule.

action_detail.en: Upgrade services using THttpRotater and verify the next scheduled rotation.
action_detail.fr: Mettez à niveau les services THttpRotater et vérifiez la prochaine rotation.
action_detail.zh: 升级使用 THttpRotater 的服务，并验证下一次计划 rotation。
action_detail.ru: Обновите services с THttpRotater и проверьте следующую rotation.

headline.en: TSynCache resets only after its deadline
headline.fr: TSynCache se réinitialise seulement après l’échéance
headline.zh: TSynCache 仅在 deadline 后 reset
headline.ru: TSynCache сбрасывается только после deadline

what_changed.en: TSynCache.ResetIfNeeded now requires a nonzero fTimeoutTix and resets when the current tick reaches or passes it, replacing the reversed future-deadline check.
what_changed.fr: ResetIfNeeded exige fTimeoutTix non nul et reset lorsque le tick atteint l’échéance, corrigeant la comparaison inversée.
what_changed.zh: TSynCache.ResetIfNeeded 现要求 fTimeoutTix 非零，并在当前 tick 到达或超过 deadline 时 reset，替代反向的未来 deadline 检查。
what_changed.ru: TSynCache.ResetIfNeeded требует nonzero fTimeoutTix и сбрасывает при достижении deadline вместо обратной проверки.

impact.en: Caches stop being cleared before expiry and now expire at the configured moment on Delphi and FPC.
impact.fr: Les caches ne sont plus vidés avant expiration et expirent au moment configuré.
impact.zh: Delphi/FPC cache 不再提前清空，并会在配置时间正确过期。
impact.ru: Caches больше не очищаются до expiry и истекают в настроенный момент на Delphi/FPC.

action_detail.en: Upgrade users of timed TSynCache instances and retest hit retention and expiry.
action_detail.fr: Mettez à niveau les TSynCache temporisés et retestez rétention/expiration.
action_detail.zh: 升级使用定时 TSynCache 的代码，并重测命中保留与过期。
action_detail.ru: Обновите timed TSynCache и повторите tests retention/expiry.

headline.en: Async WebSocket heartbeats run again
headline.fr: Les heartbeats WebSocket async fonctionnent à nouveau
headline.zh: 异步 WebSocket heartbeat 恢复运行
headline.ru: Async WebSocket heartbeats снова работают

what_changed.en: TAsyncConnections.IdleEverySecond compares the current second against each allowed callback time, replacing the erroneous comparison between allowed and garbage-collection cutoff.
what_changed.fr: IdleEverySecond compare la seconde courante à l’instant autorisé, au lieu de comparer allowed au cutoff GC.
what_changed.zh: TAsyncConnections.IdleEverySecond 改为将当前秒数与每个允许 callback 时间比较，不再错误比较 allowed 与 GC cutoff。
what_changed.ru: IdleEverySecond сравнивает текущую секунду с allowed callback time вместо ошибочного сравнения allowed с GC cutoff.

impact.en: TWebSocketAsyncConnections heartbeat callbacks no longer stop after the default memory-release threshold, restoring liveness traffic and stale-peer detection.
impact.fr: Les callbacks heartbeat ne s’arrêtent plus après le seuil mémoire, restaurant liveness et détection des peers morts.
impact.zh: TWebSocketAsyncConnections heartbeat callback 不再于默认内存释放阈值后停止，恢复存活流量与 stale-peer 检测。
impact.ru: Heartbeat callbacks больше не останавливаются после memory threshold, восстанавливая liveness и stale-peer detection.

action_detail.en: Upgrade WebSocket async servers immediately and remove the temporary LastOperationReleaseMemorySeconds=0 workaround after validation.
action_detail.fr: Mettez à niveau immédiatement et retirez le workaround LastOperationReleaseMemorySeconds=0 après validation.
action_detail.zh: 异步 WebSocket server 应立即升级，验证后移除临时 LastOperationReleaseMemorySeconds=0 workaround。
action_detail.ru: Сразу обновите async WebSocket servers и после проверки уберите workaround LastOperationReleaseMemorySeconds=0.

headline.en: Windows proxy caches enable direct IOCP writes
headline.fr: Les proxy caches Windows activent les écritures IOCP directes
headline.zh: Windows proxy cache 启用 IOCP 直接写入
headline.ru: Windows proxy cache включает direct IOCP writes

what_changed.en: A public hsoIocpWriteDirect server option maps to acoIocpWriteDirect, and THttpProxyServer enables it by default to reduce queued write handoffs on Windows IOCP.
what_changed.fr: L’option publique hsoIocpWriteDirect mappe acoIocpWriteDirect et THttpProxyServer l’active par défaut sous Windows IOCP.
what_changed.zh: 新增 public hsoIocpWriteDirect server option，映射到 acoIocpWriteDirect；THttpProxyServer 在 Windows IOCP 上默认启用以减少排队写入切换。
what_changed.ru: Public hsoIocpWriteDirect мапит acoIocpWriteDirect; THttpProxyServer включает его по умолчанию для Windows IOCP.

impact.en: Windows proxy-cache throughput should scale with less write-queue contention; non-Windows backends and servers without the option retain their path.
impact.fr: Le débit proxy cache Windows réduit la contention ; les autres backends gardent leur chemin.
impact.zh: Windows proxy-cache 吞吐可减少 write-queue 竞争；非 Windows backend 及未启用该选项的 server 保持原路径。
impact.ru: Windows proxy-cache получает меньше write-queue contention; non-Windows и servers без option не меняются.

action_detail.en: Benchmark proxy-cache throughput and latency on Windows before and after the default change.
action_detail.fr: Benchmarquez débit et latence du proxy cache Windows.
action_detail.zh: 对比 benchmark Windows proxy-cache 吞吐与延迟。
action_detail.ru: Сравните benchmark throughput/latency Windows proxy cache.

note.fr: Active le traitement direct des écritures IOCP.
note.zh: 启用 IOCP 直接写入处理。

headline.en: Async sockets can process IOCP writes directly
headline.fr: Les sockets async peuvent traiter IOCP directement
headline.zh: 异步 socket 可直接处理 IOCP 写入
headline.ru: Async sockets могут обрабатывать IOCP writes напрямую

what_changed.en: TAsyncConnectionsOptions gains acoIocpWriteDirect and the Windows write path may call TPollAsyncSockets.ProcessWrite directly before falling back to the queue.
what_changed.fr: TAsyncConnectionsOptions gagne acoIocpWriteDirect et Windows peut appeler ProcessWrite directement avant la queue.
what_changed.zh: TAsyncConnectionsOptions 新增 acoIocpWriteDirect；Windows 写路径可先直接调用 TPollAsyncSockets.ProcessWrite，再回退到 queue。
what_changed.ru: TAsyncConnectionsOptions получил acoIocpWriteDirect; Windows write path может вызвать ProcessWrite напрямую до fallback queue.

impact.en: Opt-in Windows async servers can reduce dispatch overhead; Delphi and FPC POSIX paths are unchanged.
impact.fr: Les serveurs async Windows opt-in réduisent l’overhead ; les chemins POSIX ne changent pas.
impact.zh: 选择启用的 Windows async server 可降低 dispatch overhead；Delphi/FPC POSIX 路径不变。
impact.ru: Opt-in Windows async servers снижают dispatch overhead; Delphi/FPC POSIX paths не меняются.

action_detail.en: Enable only through the server option and stress concurrent large responses on Windows.
action_detail.fr: Activez via l’option serveur et stressez les grandes réponses concurrentes sous Windows.
action_detail.zh: 仅通过 server option 启用，并在 Windows 上压测并发大响应。
action_detail.ru: Включайте через server option и stress-test concurrent large responses на Windows.

note.en: Requests direct Windows IOCP write processing.
note.fr: Demande les écritures IOCP directes Windows.
note.zh: 请求 Windows IOCP 直接写入处理。
note.ru: Запрашивает direct Windows IOCP write processing.

note.en: Adds a defaulted direct-processing parameter on Windows.
note.fr: Ajoute un paramètre Windows direct avec valeur par défaut.
note.zh: Windows 下新增带默认值的 direct-processing 参数。
note.ru: Добавлен defaulted direct-processing parameter на Windows.

headline.en: Redirects can force a fresh HTTP connection
headline.fr: Les redirects peuvent forcer une nouvelle connexion HTTP
headline.zh: Redirect 可强制建立新 HTTP 连接
headline.ru: Redirect может принудительно открыть новое HTTP connection

what_changed.en: THttpRedirectOption gains hroForceReconnect so THttpClientSocket closes and reopens its socket for every redirect, including same-origin targets.
what_changed.fr: THttpRedirectOption gagne hroForceReconnect pour fermer et rouvrir le socket à chaque redirect, même same-origin.
what_changed.zh: THttpRedirectOption 新增 hroForceReconnect，使 THttpClientSocket 对每次 redirect（含 same-origin）关闭并重开 socket。
what_changed.ru: THttpRedirectOption получил hroForceReconnect: THttpClientSocket переоткрывает socket при каждом redirect, включая same-origin.

impact.en: Clients behind SQUID/E2Guardian can avoid stale or misrouted reused connections; the empty default option set preserves existing behavior.
impact.fr: Les clients derrière SQUID/E2Guardian évitent les connexions réutilisées incorrectes ; le défaut reste inchangé.
impact.zh: 位于 SQUID/E2Guardian 后的 client 可避免陈旧或错误路由的复用连接；默认空 option set 保持现有行为。
impact.ru: Clients за SQUID/E2Guardian избегают stale/misrouted reused connections; empty default сохраняет behavior.

action_detail.en: Enable hroForceReconnect only for affected proxy paths and measure the connection cost.
action_detail.fr: Activez hroForceReconnect seulement pour les proxies affectés et mesurez le coût.
action_detail.zh: 仅对受影响 proxy 路径启用 hroForceReconnect，并衡量连接成本。
action_detail.ru: Включайте hroForceReconnect только для affected proxy paths и измерьте connection cost.

note.fr: Force la recréation du socket sur redirect.
note.zh: 强制 redirect 时重建 socket。

headline.en: HTTP proxy keep-alive uses the proxy-specific header
headline.fr: Le keep-alive proxy utilise le header dédié
headline.zh: HTTP proxy keep-alive 使用代理专用 header
headline.ru: HTTP proxy keep-alive использует специальный header

what_changed.en: THttpClientSocket sends Proxy-Connection: Keep-Alive for proxy traffic while retaining Connection handling for direct requests and close semantics.
what_changed.fr: THttpClientSocket envoie Proxy-Connection: Keep-Alive via proxy tout en conservant Connection pour les requêtes directes.
what_changed.zh: THttpClientSocket 对 proxy 流量发送 Proxy-Connection: Keep-Alive，直接请求与关闭语义仍使用 Connection 处理。
what_changed.ru: THttpClientSocket отправляет Proxy-Connection: Keep-Alive для proxy traffic, сохраняя Connection для direct requests и close.

impact.en: Connections through SQUID-style proxies are less likely to be closed or mishandled because the intended hop-by-hop header is explicit.
impact.fr: Les connexions via SQUID sont moins susceptibles d’être fermées ou mal gérées.
impact.zh: 通过 SQUID 类 proxy 的连接因明确使用目标 hop-by-hop header 而更少被关闭或误处理。
impact.ru: Connections через SQUID-style proxy реже закрываются или обрабатываются неверно благодаря явному header.

action_detail.en: Upgrade affected proxy clients and test persistent HEAD and GET requests.
action_detail.fr: Mettez à niveau les clients proxy et testez HEAD/GET persistants.
action_detail.zh: 升级受影响 proxy client，并测试持久 HEAD/GET 请求。
action_detail.ru: Обновите affected proxy clients и проверьте persistent HEAD/GET.

headline.en: Proxy-cache deletion aborts safely during shutdown
headline.fr: La suppression proxy cache s’arrête sûrement au shutdown
headline.zh: Proxy-cache 删除在 shutdown 时安全中止
headline.ru: Proxy-cache deletion безопасно прерывается при shutdown

what_changed.en: THttpProxyServer clears fUrlSet on Stop and remote-IP changes and checks it during slow directory deletion, preventing background work from continuing against invalidated state.
what_changed.fr: THttpProxyServer efface fUrlSet à Stop/changement IP et le vérifie pendant les suppressions lentes.
what_changed.zh: THttpProxyServer 在 Stop 或 remote-IP 变化时清除 fUrlSet，并在慢速目录删除期间检查它，避免后台工作继续访问失效状态。
what_changed.ru: THttpProxyServer очищает fUrlSet при Stop/IP change и проверяет его во время slow directory deletion.

impact.en: Proxy-cache shutdown and reconfiguration avoid background access to stale URL state, reducing crash and race exposure.
impact.fr: Shutdown et reconfiguration évitent l’accès background à un état URL périmé.
impact.zh: Proxy-cache shutdown 与重新配置可避免后台访问过期 URL 状态，降低 crash/race 风险。
impact.ru: Proxy-cache shutdown/reconfiguration избегают background access к stale URL state, снижая crash/race risk.

action_detail.en: Take with the startup guard and stress Stop or SetRemoteIP during large cache deletion.
action_detail.fr: Prenez avec le guard startup et stressez Stop/SetRemoteIP pendant une suppression.
action_detail.zh: 与 startup guard 一并采用，并在大型 cache 删除时压测 Stop/SetRemoteIP。
action_detail.ru: Берите вместе со startup guard и stress-test Stop/SetRemoteIP во время удаления cache.

headline.en: Proxy-cache startup no longer races its idle worker
headline.fr: Le démarrage proxy cache ne race plus le worker idle
headline.zh: Proxy-cache 启动不再与 idle worker race
headline.ru: Proxy-cache startup больше не race с idle worker

what_changed.en: THttpProxyServer adds an fUrlSet readiness flag and makes OnIdle exit until URL initialization has completed, addressing a documented random GPF during startup.
what_changed.fr: THttpProxyServer ajoute fUrlSet et fait sortir OnIdle avant la fin de l’initialisation URL, corrigeant un GPF aléatoire.
what_changed.zh: THttpProxyServer 新增 fUrlSet readiness flag，使 OnIdle 在 URL 初始化完成前退出，修复启动时记录的随机 GPF。
what_changed.ru: THttpProxyServer добавляет fUrlSet readiness flag; OnIdle выходит до завершения URL initialization, устраняя random GPF.

impact.en: Production proxy caches avoid an initialization race that could crash the process before Start completed.
impact.fr: Les proxy caches évitent une race d’initialisation pouvant crasher avant la fin de Start.
impact.zh: 生产 proxy cache 避免可能在 Start 完成前使进程 crash 的初始化 race。
impact.ru: Production proxy cache избегает initialization race, способной crash процесс до завершения Start.

action_detail.en: Upgrade proxy-cache deployments and include the following shutdown/deletion guard.
action_detail.fr: Mettez à niveau les proxy caches avec le guard shutdown suivant.
action_detail.zh: 升级 proxy-cache 部署，并包含下一 commit 的 shutdown/delete guard。
action_detail.ru: Обновите proxy-cache deployments вместе со следующим shutdown/deletion guard.

headline.en: SSPI exceptions report the SSPI error they received
headline.fr: Les exceptions SSPI rapportent l’erreur SSPI reçue
headline.zh: SSPI exception 现报告实际 SSPI error
headline.ru: SSPI exceptions сообщают полученный SSPI error

what_changed.en: ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError is renamed RaiseSspiError and builds its message from the supplied SSPI status instead of appending unrelated GetLastError state; internal Check becomes CheckOK.
what_changed.fr: ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError devient RaiseSspiError et utilise le statut SSPI fourni au lieu de GetLastError ; Check devient CheckOK.
what_changed.zh: ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError 重命名为 RaiseSspiError，并从传入 SSPI status 构建消息，不再附加无关 GetLastError；内部 Check 改为 CheckOK。
what_changed.ru: ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError переименован в RaiseSspiError и использует переданный SSPI status вместо unrelated GetLastError; internal Check стал CheckOK.

impact.en: Windows authentication and TLS diagnostics become accurate, while external code calling the public exception helper no longer compiles until renamed.
impact.fr: Les diagnostics Windows deviennent exacts ; les appels externes à l’ancien helper ne compilent plus.
impact.zh: Windows authentication/TLS 诊断更准确；调用该 public exception helper 的外部代码在重命名前无法编译。
impact.ru: Windows auth/TLS diagnostics становятся точными; external calls старого public helper не компилируются.

action_detail.en: Grep for ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError and replace it with ESynSspi.RaiseSspiError.
action_detail.fr: Cherchez ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError et remplacez par ESynSspi.RaiseSspiError.
action_detail.zh: 搜索 ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError，并替换为 ESynSspi.RaiseSspiError。
action_detail.ru: Найдите ESynSspi.RaiseLastOSError и замените на ESynSspi.RaiseSspiError.

note.en: Renamed to RaiseSspiError and now reports the supplied SSPI status.
note.fr: Renommé RaiseSspiError et rapporte le statut SSPI fourni.
note.zh: 重命名为 RaiseSspiError，并报告传入 SSPI status。
note.ru: Переименован в RaiseSspiError и сообщает supplied SSPI status.

headline.en: Tests adapt to translation layers and older curl
headline.fr: Les tests s’adaptent aux couches de traduction et anciens curl
headline.zh: 测试适配 translation layer 与旧版 curl
headline.ru: Tests адаптированы к translation layers и старому curl

what_changed.en: RSA key generation relaxes its timeout under Windows PRISM, symbol discovery skips SynLogVectoredHandler, and TFTP integration tests are gated for curl versions with known retransmission problems.
what_changed.fr: RSA relâche son timeout sous Windows PRISM, le symbol discovery ignore SynLogVectoredHandler et les tests TFTP filtrent les versions curl problématiques.
what_changed.zh: RSA key generation 在 Windows PRISM 下放宽 timeout，symbol discovery 跳过 SynLogVectoredHandler，TFTP 集成测试对存在重传问题的 curl 版本加 gate。
what_changed.ru: RSA timeout ослаблен под Windows PRISM, symbol discovery пропускает SynLogVectoredHandler, TFTP tests gated для проблемных curl versions.

impact.en: CI and emulated Windows environments see fewer false failures; application behavior changes only by allowing a longer RSA timeout under PRISM.
impact.fr: CI et Windows émulé ont moins de faux échecs ; seul le timeout RSA sous PRISM change.
impact.zh: CI 与模拟 Windows 环境减少误报；应用行为仅在 PRISM 下允许更长 RSA timeout。
impact.ru: CI и emulated Windows получают меньше false failures; application behavior меняется только longer RSA timeout под PRISM.

action_detail.en: No migration; keep the relaxed timeout in mind when testing RSA generation under PRISM.
action_detail.fr: Aucune migration ; notez le timeout RSA plus long sous PRISM.
action_detail.zh: 无需迁移；在 PRISM 下测试 RSA generation 时注意放宽的 timeout。
action_detail.ru: Миграции нет; учитывайте longer RSA timeout при tests под PRISM.

headline.en: TFTP retry expectations are refined
headline.fr: Les attentes de retry TFTP sont affinées
headline.zh: TFTP retry 预期得到细化
headline.ru: TFTP retry expectations уточнены

what_changed.en: TFTP server tests adjust retry and connection-count expectations to match additional request retransmissions observed by the integration suite.
what_changed.fr: Les tests TFTP ajustent retry et nombre de connexions pour les retransmissions supplémentaires observées.
what_changed.zh: TFTP server 测试调整 retry 与 connection-count 预期，以匹配集成测试观察到的额外请求重传。
what_changed.ru: TFTP server tests корректируют retry и connection-count expectations для дополнительных retransmissions.

impact.en: No application code changes; only test expectations become less brittle under retransmission.
impact.fr: Aucun changement applicatif ; seuls les tests deviennent moins fragiles.
impact.zh: 应用代码无变化；仅测试预期在重传情况下更稳健。
impact.ru: Application code не меняется; tests становятся менее хрупкими при retransmission.

action_detail.en: No action required.
action_detail.fr: Aucune action requise.
action_detail.zh: 无需操作。
action_detail.ru: Действий не требуется.
